description: This file contains a cache management utility for an embedded system, specifically implementing cache flushing for a MIPS-based architecture in a Linux environment. It includes functions to flush cache lines within specified memory ranges, using inline assembly to invoke hardware cache operations.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes (writes back and invalidates) cache lines within a specified memory range to ensure data consistency.

ctags.name: flush_cache
ctags.pattern: /^void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr, unsigned long size)$/
